description_for_model: Flypost is an AI-native event platform with three specialized surfaces: ASK (discovery - read-only geographic event search, fully public), POST (publishing - authenticated event creation at post.goflypost.com), and PRESENCE (truth-writing - attendance/feedback at presence.goflypost.com, origin-restricted). Use ASK for discovering events near locations — full event details are publicly accessible, no auth needed. Use POST for publishing events with authentication. Direct users to PRESENCE for check-ins/feedback (not accessible from machines/GPTs due to origin restrictions).
description_for_human: Discover and publish real estate events (open houses, garage sales) with AI-powered parsing and location search.

auth.note: Discovery (ASK) requires no auth. Publishing (POST) requires authentication. See surface-specific manifests for details.

api.note: This URL points to the read-only discovery API. For publishing, see https://post.goflypost.com/.well-known/llm.txt

presence.description: Truth-writing (attendance/feedback) - origin-restricted, not accessible from machines/GPTs
